other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding on the training data without using out-of-fold or leave-one-out techniques, meaning the target of a row is included in its own encoded feature, leading to severe target leakage.

summary: The solution employs extensive and creative feature engineering but suffers from critical target leakage due to naive target encoding within training folds. Furthermore, spatial transformers are fit on test data, and randomized cross-validation ignores the temporal nature of the trips.
